SELECT tmp.* FROM ( SELECT t.*, CONCAT(t.org_code, '_', t.safety_role_code) as depart_safety_code, CONCAT(t.org_code, '_', t.manager_role_code) as depart_manager_code, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, t.update_time, NOW()) >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS updateStatus FROM ytsafety_risk_data t ${ew.customSqlSegment} ) tmp
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT depart_code, role_code FROM ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping WHERE depart_code IS NOT NULL AND role_code IS NOT NULL AND (emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyStaffName}, '%') OR emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyStaffName}, '%')) ) staff_mapping ON staff_mapping.depart_code = tmp.org_code AND staff_mapping.role_code = tmp.safety_role_code
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT depart_code, role_code FROM ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping WHERE depart_code IS NOT NULL AND role_code IS NOT NULL AND (emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyManagerName}, '%') OR emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyManagerName}, '%')) ) manager_mapping ON manager_mapping.depart_code = tmp.org_code AND manager_mapping.role_code = tmp.manager_role_code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT depart_code, role_code FROM ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping WHERE depart_code IS NOT NULL AND role_code IS NOT NULL AND (emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')) ) keyword_mapping ON keyword_mapping.depart_code = tmp.org_code AND keyword_mapping.role_code = tmp.safety_role_code
WHERE tmp.del_flag=0
AND ( CONCAT_WS(',', tmp.risk_code, tmp.location_name, tmp.risk_factor_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR keyword_mapping.depart_code IS NOT NULL )
order by tmp.update_time desc
SELECT tmp.* FROM ( SELECT t.* FROM ytsafety_risk_data t WHERE t.id = #{id} ) tmp WHERE tmp.del_flag=0

SELECT tmp.* FROM ( SELECT t.*, CONCAT(t.org_code, '_', t.safety_role_code) as depart_safety_code, CONCAT(t.org_code, '_', t.manager_role_code) as depart_manager_code, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, t.update_time, NOW()) >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS updateStatus FROM ytsafety_risk_data t ${ew.customSqlSegment} ) tmp
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT depart_code, role_code FROM ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping WHERE depart_code IS NOT NULL AND role_code IS NOT NULL AND (emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyStaffName}, '%') OR emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyStaffName}, '%')) ) staff_mapping ON staff_mapping.depart_code = tmp.org_code AND staff_mapping.role_code = tmp.safety_role_code
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT depart_code, role_code FROM ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping WHERE depart_code IS NOT NULL AND role_code IS NOT NULL AND (emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyManagerName}, '%') OR emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyManagerName}, '%')) ) manager_mapping ON manager_mapping.depart_code = tmp.org_code AND manager_mapping.role_code = tmp.manager_role_code
WHERE tmp.del_flag=0 order by tmp.update_time desc

SELECT t.names FROM ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.emp_name SEPARATOR ',') AS names, FIND_IN_SET(m.depart_code, gi.org_code_path) AS depth FROM safety_group_info gi INNER JOIN ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping m ON FIND_IN_SET(m.depart_code, gi.org_code_path) > 0 AND m.role_code = #{roleCode} WHERE gi.status = 'Y' AND gi.code = #{orgCode} GROUP BY m.depart_code, gi.org_code_path ) t ORDER BY t.depth DESC LIMIT 1
